replies.reply: I don't quote a price before understanding scope. What do you want customers to do when they see your pitch—call, WhatsApp, book or fill a form?

replies.if_they_say: do you do this for my kind of business?
replies.reply: It works for any service sold to local businesses, whatever you sell—marketing, design, SEO, coaching, accounting and more. What kind of business do you sell to?
